entries.finding: abstract says the GA obtains a global optimum with Gap=0 in 1.5 h; no exact bound/certificate/reference optimum establishing a zero optimality gap is visible
three objectives are scalarized into one weighted utility (0.5/0.3/0.2 in Table 4.11); this is one preference point, not a Pareto multiobjective solution
S/R normalization uses current population minima/maxima, so objective scaling and fitness semantics can move between generations; cross-generation score comparability is not fixed
Pmutation=Pbase+alpha*(1-ConvergenceRate) becomes smaller as convergence/similarity-to-best increases, opposite the prose statement that mutation should rise when diversity falls

order crossover can preserve permutation uniqueness/order fragments but does not guarantee that consecutive vertices are connected by valid graph edges; final route feasibility/repair must be explicit

Pearson correlation recomputed from the 10 table rows is r=0.989714, not 0.89. Because scenic score is itself a positive component of fitness, this correlation is also endogenous rather than independent validation.

Eq.(5-14) weights sum to 1 and its I1-I5 components are defined/intended with maxima <=1, implying Aestheticlayout<=1; grade thresholds 1.5-3.6 and reported 4.620 cannot be produced by the displayed scale contract
the paper defines five landscape themes but normalizes both Hspatial and Htheme with Hmax=log2(6); theme entropy maximum should depend on K (five here) unless a sixth theme exists

recursive O_ij multiplies sqrt(open-area fraction) by 1+neighbor previous openness and has no visible initialization, convergence, or clipping rule; it can exceed 1 while later Openness thresholds assume a 0-1 scale
R(tau) is an autocovariance-like quantity; dividing by sqrt(R(0)) does not produce the usual dimensionless normalized autocorrelation and does not establish a [0,1] rhythm index
Ascale=1+beta*ln(A/A_Jichang) is monotone increasing in area, so it rewards larger gardens rather than expressing an optimum at a moderate scale as the prose claims

Sstd anchors Jichang at 100, but Srelative multiplies this by 1+gamma*Similarity and final score multiplies additional factors that may exceed 1; without an unshown cap/renormalization, 100 is not a theoretical maximum and Jichang would generally exceed 100

component columns (element-distribution score, openness score, adjustment coefficient) are insufficient by themselves to replay the final score because similarity and anchor-normalization terms are not registered per garden
the judgment matrix is defined as a_ij=w_i/w_j and then w is obtained as its eigenvector; if w is unknown this is circular, while if w is already known the eigenproblem does not derive expert weights

the model fuses cosine, set Jaccard and weighted-Euclidean similarity, then describes Ward minimum-variance clustering. Direct Ward use on arbitrary fused similarity is not justified without a Euclidean feature embedding/distance contract
p-value>0.05 is used to confirm a feature as common across groups; non-significance does not establish equivalence/commonality, especially with only ten gardens
text says all garden similarities are above 0.93, but Table 6.2 off-diagonal values range from 0.523 to 0.847
45-pair replay gives mean=0.664267, sample SD=0.068578; paper reports mean 0.632 and SD 0.089. The displayed matrix therefore does not reproduce the stated summary statistics.
from the table memberships, pairwise means are large=0.660667, medium=0.740333, small=0.673333; reported 0.721/0.741/0.735 only matches the medium group closely
opening abstract says Zhuozheng Garden score 6.353 ranks first; the Q3 abstract paragraph and Table 6.6 assign 6.353/rank 1 to Jichang Garden
Table 6.6 ranks Jichang, Lingering, Yiyuan first-three; following prose instead says Zhuozheng and Lingering are first-two and Shen Garden ranks third

entries.surface: Table 6.4 cluster groups vs Table 6.6 type labels
entries.finding: Table 6.6 reassigns several gardens to different type labels than the Ward cluster groups in Table 6.4 without a new taxonomy contract

2/3=66.7% arithmetic is correct, but “correct classification” ground-truth labels are not predeclared/independently sourced and Huanxiu is described as an independent category outside the learned three-group scheme
mean similarity prediction error 0.078 is reported without a visible ground-truth similarity label or target definition against which prediction error is computed

global_gates: adaptive formulas must be direction-checked against their prose intent
GA crossover/repair must replay graph feasibility on final routes
constructed score ranges must be algebraically compatible with component ranges
entropy/rhythm/open-score normalizers require correct support and units
score anchors/adjustment factors must close the declared output range
AHP weights require independent pairwise-judgment provenance
Ward requires valid Euclidean geometry or an appropriate linkage for the chosen distance
pairwise similarity statistics and cluster means must be replayed from one matrix registry
external accuracy needs a predeclared truth target
